Resin River Wall Plaque

Resin Art · 6 colorways

A live-edge walnut river runs through a pour of deep resin, opening into a heart of blue-and-silver druzy crystal like a geode split by hand. Gilded botanical leaves climb the border. Poured one at a time — every river runs differently, so no two are ever alike.

Beach Shore Memorial Block

Memorial Piece · 3 colorways

A single ocean wave caught mid-break above real beach sand, tiny shells and a piece of sea glass — a quiet keepsake of someone, or somewhere, you love. Each block can be personalized with a name and dates in gold or white lettering. Choose an Emerald, Amethyst, or Black tide.

Emerald Beach Memorial Coasters

Memorial Piece

A set of coasters that carry the same emerald shoreline as the memorial blocks — real sand, tiny shells, a curl of white surf, and an optional gold name. A small, everyday way to keep someone close.
